title: Improper Neutralization of Input During Web Page Generation ('Cross-site Scripting') vulnerability in BdThemes Prime…
description: A stored cross-site scripting (XSS) vulnerability exists in BdThemes Prime Slider – Addons For Elementor up to version 5.1.2. This vulnerability allows improper neutralization of input during web page generation, potentially enabling attackers to execute malicious scripts in users' browsers.
